items.title: SkinPaint minor 3: an EditBox's face goes back by path, never its anonymous font object (owner smoke crash)
items.spec: Owner smoke 2026-10-26: LootHistory Forever -> Midnight crashed the client, STACK_OVERFLOW (Errors/2026-10-26_11.54.58_Crash_48668.txt). Lua stack: OptionsAppearance -> Skin:SetChoice('midnight') -> Repaint -> prim.EditBox (SkinPaintControls.lua:154) -> P.font -> P.unfont -> SkinPaint.lua:400 EditBox:SetFontObject(Font <UnknownFile:0>). Owner probe: CreateFrame('EditBox'):SetFontObject(GameFontHighlightSmall) then :GetFontObject() is an unnamed Font, ~= GameFontHighlightSmall. Fix: P.font records a prior font object only when it is a named font (a global font name, or an object whose GetName answers one) that is not the target; otherwise P.unfont restores the face by SetFont(path, size, flags). Test first (red on minor 2), SkinPaint minor bump, in-flight docs/api Skin key git mv'd, CHANGELOG v1.78.0 extended, no tag, no push; the lead re-runs the release battery and re-cuts the local tag.

items.title: The holder-move rollup test reads the clock its sample was stamped with
items.spec: Found while gating LH-RV4: 'TestData: the sample rollup books a holder move's loss and gain on each holder' fails on master and on the run branch from 2026-10-26. BrowserTable:BuildTestData stamps rows time() - age from the real clock; the test passed TestData.Build a fixed now of 2026-10-06, so the sample drifted out of the pinned window. Fix the test to read T.mocks.time() (the test_util.lua:490 idiom); no addon code changes.
